title: LLCO goal record (draft 0.1)
description: One recovered production goal from a legacy automation estate, with its three separate claims (behaviour, purpose, correctness), its concern classification, its choices and its coverage items. Adapter-local to LLCO per USG direction docs/proposals/legacy-automation-purpose-recovery.md (LOG-0023): fields stay in LLCO until a second adapter needs them; everything handed to USG maps to existing concepts (statement_model, evidence_model, rule_model, pending_user). Not canonical USG schema.

record_kind.description: recovered: grounded in an observed estate at a pinned commit. hypothetical: invented illustration, never evidence of a real firm; requires hypothetical_notice.

hypothetical_notice.description: Required when record_kind is hypothetical. States that the record is invented and is not evidence.

source.description: The recovered kernel this goal is about, pinned. Required when record_kind is recovered.

related_rule_records.description: Derived back-references to LLCO rule records. The many-to-many link lives on the goal side (coverage.ref and this list); rule records carry no mandatory goal field.

behaviour.description: 'Routine R gives output Y for input X.' Recorded runs confirm only for tested inputs; a substitute runtime counts only where calibrated.

purpose.description: 'R exists to achieve P for beneficiary B.' Supporting evidence never confirms; only the authorized process owner (human authority) does. confirmed_positive therefore requires a human_ruling evidence item.

correctness.description: 'Y is what the process should produce.' Decided by governing documents and the process owner; regulated content goes to professional_review. A long-used defect is a behaviour fact, not evidence of correctness.

basis.description: Maps LLCO authority claims onto USG statement_model.basis: firm convention -> stakeholder_choice (relaxable by the firm); client requirement -> stakeholder_choice (relaxable by the client); code -> legal; drafting habit -> preference or assumption; unknown -> open.

relaxable_by.description: Who may change the underlying choice (firm, client, process owner), or null when not relaxable (legal) or unknown.

basis_note.description: Why this basis is claimed, with the source of the claim (e.g. the rule record's authority block).

concern.description: outcome/condition = essential logic; means = platform mechanism or era constraint (does not descend as a requirement).

means_reason.description: Required when concern is means. Adapter-local refinement of USG statement_model.concerns; no protocol field.

choices.description: The option space the estate covers. Two scopes kept apart: object_rule (inside a document) vs catalogue_availability (what can be sold at all). Maps to rule_model on the USG side.

status.description: Open choices must surface in pending_user; readiness requires every choice to have a status.

required_outputs.description: Every output the process needs from this kernel. Readiness item 1: all listed before successor design.

invariant.description: Target-independent invariant, never a tool command.

read_back.description: How the invariant is checked with read-back evidence.

basis.description: Reference outputs the successor must reproduce.

element_scope.description: Which elements the reference covers; what is out of scope must be stated.

reconciliation.description: Coverage-based readiness (LOG-0023): a reconciled case is a past released output reproduced with read-back evidence. Coverage, not a count; the engagement owner may raise the bar. A second runner must re-run.

runner.description: Who re-ran the case; the second-runner re-run is part of the basis.

what.description: The goal slice this item covers.

disposition.description: undecided blocks binding output that depends on it; uncovered_gap is never silent.

coverage_kind.description: Required for native_coverage: which kind of coverage, kept distinct. Needs versioned primary-source evidence.

ref.description: Derived back-reference to a rule record that carries this item's logic, if any.

authority.description: Who decided / holds the decision (open until ruled).

reason.description: Required for native_coverage (as basis), retire and undecided.

pending_user.description: Open items for the pending_user gate; high-materiality open items block binding output.

kind.description: static_reading/interpreter_probe/recorded_run/human_ruling/source_comment match LLCO's rule-record kinds; historical_output/governing_document/owner_statement are the goal-side additions. interpreter_probe never raises a claim to confirmed; recorded_run confirms behaviour for that input only.

source_ref.description: Pinned repo@commit or other versioned primary source.

confidence.description: owner_statement and interested-party statements are capped at medium (owner_statement and reviewer_independence rules).

status.description: USG claim status per evidence_model.claim_status_rule. A claim read from code alone is insufficient.
